objective: Qualify compact conservative source for evolving 3D cube wake; keep mesh, FVM reference, native RK, diffusion, LES, health and pruning unchanged.
source_integrator: Explicit midpoint for S; symmetric S(dt/2)-native advance plus due renewal-S(dt/2).

gates.accepted_health: Every requested step must pass original final-state health checks.
gates.accuracy: At t=7 both renewal-seam and outer-wake RMS velocity errors must be below the native control at the same dt. The benefit must persist at half dt; report the change in benefit and do not call it temporally resolved if the change is as large as the benefit.
gates.source_conservation: Every float64 shared-face source has net norm <= 1e-12*max(1,L1 rate); source impulse ledger must close on applied state within f32 rounding.
gates.particle_count: No particles added by S; report ratio to native endpoint and flag >5% growth.
gates.cost: Report measured seconds/step and source-phase cost; no efficiency or production-readiness claim from accuracy alone.

bounds: One dt=.01 corrected 100-step replay, then paired dt=.005 200-step replays if the first accuracy gates pass. Stop and consult Helper on numerical/interpretation failure; no full coupled run if the isolated correction is not qualified.

execution.full_step_controls: Sequential .01 pilots; full .01 correction uses the validated historical 100-step native trajectory.
execution.half_step_controls: The .005 native and corrected jobs run concurrently, beginning 2026-09-15 around 17:23 UTC. Their overlapping wall times are not used for the performance ratio.
execution.timing_scope: Only isolated VPM plus prescribed donor renewal; no full FVM/coupler speed claim.
